==Senator Elections==
Each summit, a number of nations will elect [[Senator|senators]] for one or more of their territories to serve in the [[Senate]]. Each nation has a unique method of electing its senators. At the Winter Solstice 387YE, the following nations will elect Senators at the times listed in the table below, inside each nation's camp.
<table class="wikitable sortable mw-collapsible">
<tr><th>Nation</th><th>Time</th><th>Territories with Senator elections</th><th>Notes</th></tr>
<tr><td>[[The Brass Coast leadership|Brass Coast]]</td><td>1:00pm</td><td>[[Madruga]]</td><td>Auction begins</td></tr>
<tr><td>[[Dawn leadership|Dawn]]</td><td>2:30pm</td><td>[[Astolat]]</td><td>Immediately after the tourney</td></tr>
<tr><td>[[Highguard leadership|Highguard]]</td><td>2:00pm</td><td>[[Necropolis]]</td><td>Inquisition of candidates begins</td></tr>
<tr><td>[[Imperial Orcs leadership|Imperial Orcs]]</td><td>2:15pm</td><td>[[Skarsind]]</td><td>Candidates begin presenting items of [[worth]]</td></tr>
<tr><td>[[The League leadership|League]]</td><td>3:30pm</td><td>[[Temeschwar]]</td><td>Presentation of collected bonds</td></tr>
<tr><td>[[Navarr leadership|Navarr]]</td><td>1:15pm</td><td>[[Hercynia]]</td><td>Immediately after standing</td></tr>
<tr><td>[[Urizen leadership|Urizen]]</td><td>1:00pm</td><td>[[Zenith]]<br>[[Sarangrave]]<sup>[[#1|(1)]]</sup></td><td>Demos begins (to conclude at 1:30pm)</td></tr>
<tr><td>[[Varushka leadership|Varushka]]</td><td>1:45pm</td><td>[[Miekarova]]<br>[[Ossium]]</td><td>Questioning of candidates begins</td></tr>
<tr><td>[[Wintermark political leadership|Wintermark]]</td><td>2:00pm</td><td>[[Kallavesa]]</td><td>Jars are placed down for 15 minutes</td></tr>
</table>
<small>
#{{anchor|1}} The next regular election for this senatorial title will take place at the Spring Equinox 388YE
</small>

==Timetable==
This timetable and much more information can be seen on the notices that get pinned up all around the Hub after time-in. <br />
For any queries regarding the IC timetabling at events you can talk to the civil service staff in the Hub.

=== Citizen Bookings ===
Citizens can request to book Civil Service spaces, as detailed [[Anvil#Booking_Civil_Service_Spaces|here]]. Official meetings organised by the Civil Service are listed in darker shading, whilst such citizen-organised meetings are shown in a lighter colour, as below.

The names of individuals responsible for each booking are published on an in-character version of the timetable which will be available in the Hub throughout the event.

<table>
<tr><td style="background-color: #b48fb4; text-align: center; vertical-align: middle;">Official Meeting</td><td style="background-color: #85ae85; text-align: center; vertical-align: middle;">Official Meeting</td></tr>
<td style="background-color: #d4afd4; text-align: center; vertical-align: middle;">Citizen-Organised Meeting</td><td style="background-color: #aaddaa; text-align: center; vertical-align: middle;">Citizen-Organised Meeting</td>
</table>
